info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Plans-v4-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Plans API empowers users to access a comprehensive list of available utility billing plans. This endpoint is designed for utility providers and service administrators who need to review and manage billing options effectively. By retrieving detailed information about each plan, consumers can make informed decisions regarding billing strategies and customer offerings. Typical use cases include integration with customer service platforms and analytics dashboards to optimize billing practices.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details about the available billing plans, including pricing, features, and any applicable limitations. Perfect for users looking to understand their options before selecting a plan.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the parameters needed for retrieving billing plan information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the billing plan details.
